/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc -forward-unknown-to-host-compiler -O3 -DNDEBUG --generate-code=arch=compute_75,code=[compute_75,sm_75] --generate-code=arch=compute_80,code=[compute_80,sm_80] --generate-code=arch=compute_86,code=[compute_86,sm_86] --generate-code=arch=compute_89,code=[compute_89,sm_89] -Xcompiler=-fPIC -Wno-deprecated-gpu-targets -shared -dlink CMakeFiles/gpu_test.dir/src/main.cu.o -o CMakeFiles/gpu_test.dir/cmake_device_link.o  -lcudadevrt -lcudart_static -lrt -lpthread -ldl
